limitations: Estimator is OLS as a best-effort choice because the paper does not name the regression estimator.

Historical SIC is taken from period-specific Compustat SICH where available, exact-date COMP.CO_INDUSTRY as the next fallback, and uniquely concordant date-effective CCM/CRSP LC P/C SIC followed by lower-confidence LU P/C SIC otherwise; remaining unavailable or ambiguous rows cannot enter a grouped fit.

The paper does not fully specify the exact match/stratification field formulas, timing, nor the winsorization cutoff grouping. Choices are documented and are not tuned to reproduce the published sample size or residual moments.

Local MKVALT is positive only in 1998–1999. The CRSP audit separates contradictory identity/price/share records from incomplete monthly inputs; missing or nonpositive PRC/SHROUT makes the linked-month aggregate unusable but is not itself treated as a contradictory company value. The PRCC_F×CSHO fallback is restricted to FIC=USA, CURCD=USD, and no observed link/CRSP identity or price/share conflict, with or without a unique LC link; price currency is still inferred. OANCF is absent before 1987, so missing direct observations use NI minus the paper-defined balance-sheet accrual amount as a best-effort OCF proxy.

Performance-matched residuals use nearest neighbors in ROA within two-digit SIC/year, exclude the focal firm, permit control reuse, and resolve equal-distance candidates by sorted ROA/GVKEY order; replacement and exact tie handling are not specified in the paper.

CRSP monthly-price support and exact-date CO_INDUSTRY queries extend through the maximum selected Compustat DATADATE of 31 May 2000. Of the 1,292 fiscal-year 1999 rows dated after December 1999 in the USD/SIC handoff, 275 have direct CRSP MVE (quote age 0-day median, 2-day maximum), 40 use a linked inferred Compustat price, 790 use the inferred no-link Compustat route, and 187 lack MVE.
